title: A laboratory's comparison of one sample with one other record by a stated genotyping method. Slot 0 is the call: 1 the genotypes match, 0 they do not. Slot 1 is the number of markers compared, slot 2 the number that differ. Which records were compared (by their proof codes), the method and the panel are in the laboratory's signed result statement (veilcore/lab-result/v2); no genotype is in either. The laboratory signs the record. Published by VeilCore (veilcore.org).
